visual.description: A man's hand pointing aggressively at the camera against a dark background.

vo.en: Place your hand flat on a table. Now, tuck your middle finger all the way under your palm.

visual.description: Close-up of a hand on a wooden desk folding the middle finger underneath.

vo.en: Try lifting your thumb and index finger. They move easily, right? But now, try lifting your ring finger.

visual.description: Macro shot of fingers attempting to lift while one is pinned down, showing effort.

vo.en: Wait until you feel the tension. It’s like your finger is paralyzed, but here is the creepy part.

visual.description: Abstract digital glitch overlaying a neural network animation representing brain signals.

vo.en: Your middle and ring fingers share the same extensor tendon. When the middle is tucked, the ring is locked.

visual.description: Medical style 3D animation of hand anatomy showing muscles and tendons moving.

vo.en: It’s a physical limitation of human anatomy. Your brain sends the signal, but your body says no.

visual.description: A man looking at his hand with a confused and frustrated expression.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment GLITCH if you failed. Most people fail because...

visual.description: Overhead view of a hand scrolling through a smartphone social media feed.
